text: Exploring the Internet is a travel book in the classic sense. In 3 trips around the world in 6 months, Carl Malamud undertakes a voyage of discovery, a look at the Internet and the emerging global village. In 21 countries and 56 cities, here are just a few of the stops in this technical travelogue: Designed to give professionals in the computer and communications fields an in-depth look at worldwide networking, this intriguing narrative helps you gain a unique technical perspective on the Internet and how it is built. Carl Malamud is the author of seven professional reference books including STACKS and a three-volume series that includes Analyzing DECnet/OSI Phase V and Analyzing Sun Networks. He has written for publications ranging from Communications Week to the Bangkok Post.
